caseName: United States v. Alaska Steamship Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. Alaska Steamship Company
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York.

opinions.text: Counsel requested to file briefs concerning the effect upon the issues herein involved resulting from the act of Congress terminating the federal control of railroads and amending the act to regulate commerce in certain particulars, approved February 28, 1920.
